channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Temporal Vessels - A Vessel Teleportation System
item.description: Teleport a storage vessel back to your base so you can continue your looting exploration adventure

item.title: Bark blocks
item.description: A simple content mod that adds bark blocks made from vanilla logs

item.title: Handy Daub
item.description: Makes adding daub to wattle fences easier by automatically swapping it to the hotbar

item.title: Craftable Wattle and Daub
item.description: Adds a recipe for crafting wattle and daub blocks

item.title: Aluminum From Bauxite
item.description: Adds aluminum metal to the game, as well as recipes to refine it from bauxite rock

item.title: The Revived Lands [PATCHES]
item.description: Assets pack for The Revived Lands Vintage Story mod set.

item.title: Burnable Roofs
item.description: Allow all flammable roofing to be used as fuel. That's it

item.title: Splittable Stone Paths
item.description: Split stone path blocks into stairs, slabs and quarters, or combine them back into full blocks

item.title: Vintage Menu
item.description: Reverts the main menu backgrounds to those from 1.21!

item.title: Fruit In Troughs
item.description: Allows all fruit types to be placed in troughs

item.title: Muppers Arcana
item.description: A book-learned magic mod: find spellbooks in ruins and from traders and learn powers.

item.title: Threnkal
item.description: A race of cow folks based on minotaurs and taurens from WoW.

item.title: Furio's Telescope
item.description: Functional Telescopes with celestial body Observation Mechanic. More features in development.

item.title: Better Jungles (and survival modpack)
item.description: More realistic Jungles, some survival gameplay changes - ideally as part of the modpack listed below

item.title: Sauna
item.description: Seal a room, light the iron stove, splash a watering can over the hot stones, and you have a sauna

item.title: The Hunter
item.description: Track prey, follow blood, carry carcasses, compost dung, and have smarter wolves.

item.title: Keep Rapids
item.description: Allows placing multiple water wheels on a single rapid stream by keeping the water as rapids.

item.title: Metal Pots & Chiseled Ground Placement Patch
item.description: Patch to add extra compatibility between Metal Cooking Pots and Chiseled Ground Placement.

item.title: Peat for Charcoal
item.description: Allows using peat bricks as a substitute for firewood + changes to Peat piles.

item.title: Colored Sashes
item.description: Adds a full set of craftable sashes like the malefactor's in different cloth colors.

item.title: Shovel that Muck
item.description: Makes Muck Shovels from IME use durability based on actual amount collected

item.title: Boat Autopilot
item.description: Long boat trips in Vintage Story are beautiful… the first three times.

item.title: Rudiments
item.description: Pre-industrial craft, done properly. Fibre, clay, kilns, stone tools, mud — one step at a time.

item.title: Purposefull Prill
item.description: Makes it possible to put prill from IME into resource bins from Purposeful Storage

item.title: Dana Can Cook and Butchering Patch
item.description: Adds bloodbreads from Butchering as a valid source for bread slices

item.title: topgsmod
item.description: TopGs Community Mod

item.title: Less Finicky Coppertail Spawns (QOL patch)
item.description: A simple JSON patch that balances the Coppertail spawns to utilize boulders for spawns.

item.title: Wash Pots
item.description: Throw a residue-covered cooking pot in water and it rinses clean, instead of being litter forever.

item.title: Carry Reinforced
item.description: Carry On, but you can move your own reinforced and locked blocks. Reinforcement travels too.

item.title: Starter Kit Bundle
item.description: New players get a deployable bundle that unpacks into a stocked starter container.
